comingLast.roast: on 17 - the two blue balls have begun their lap of honour early
above Watson by 1 - close enough to hear the engraver
one quiet stretch from joining Watson in the conversation nobody wants
his buffer is 2 - his group has stopped mentioning it, loudly
2 clear with 5 to play - points only go up, but so does the tension
